reason: A token billing and usage accounting plugin that measures model-call tokens, calculates configurable costs, persists billing history, and exposes reports through chat and interface panels.

summaries.zh: 按模型调用的 Token 用量计算费用并持久化账单，提供对话报告、统计栏和设置面板。
summaries.en: Tracks tokens used by model calls, calculates configurable costs, persists billing records, and provides reports through chat and UI panels.

capabilities: Measures token usage from model calls
Calculates costs using configurable per-model prices
Persists billing records and aggregates across sessions
Provides billing reports through a chat tool
Displays billing summaries in UI panels
Exposes local HTTP endpoints for summaries and reset operations
